requirement.statement: Bash command execution SHALL preserve the sandbox process outcome through the generic tool execution contract; non-zero exit, timeout, abort, signal termination, and spawn failure SHALL be explicit failed outcomes while preserving bounded stdout/stderr diagnostics for the model.

case.given: a Bash command starts successfully, emits ordinary test failure text, and exits with code 1
case.when: the Bash tool returns to the agent runtime
case.then: the result SHALL retain the test output and exit-code diagnostic
the generic tool outcome SHALL be failed without an executor Bash-name branch

case.given: a Bash command exits with code 0
case.when: the Bash tool returns its result
case.then: the generic tool outcome SHALL be completed

case.given: a Bash process times out or is aborted
case.when: the process outcome is mapped into the tool contract
case.then: the failed outcome SHALL use timeout or aborted failureKind respectively
